query: I work for a Singapore company and was dismissed shortly after reporting safety problems and unpaid overtime. The company says I was terminated for poor performance. What claims or protections should I investigate, what evidence should I preserve, and are there urgent filing deadlines?

I rent a condominium in Singapore. The landlord has ignored recurring mould and water leakage and now wants to keep my deposit for the resulting damage. What do the lease and Singapore law require, and what practical steps can I take to recover the deposit?

I bought a new refrigerator from a Singapore retailer, but it has failed three times in four months. The retailer says I must accept another repair and cannot seek a replacement or refund. What consumer remedies may be available and how should I pursue them?

A freelance developer in Singapore agreed by email and Telegram to build an app for my company. I paid a deposit, but the developer abandoned the work and says there was no contract because nothing was signed. Is the agreement enforceable and what remedies might I have?

I was injured in a road accident in Singapore about two years ago and my condition has worsened. How should negligence, contributory fault, and damages be analysed, and what limitation or pre-action steps should I check immediately?

My spouse and I are divorcing in Singapore after eleven years. We have two children, an HDB flat, CPF savings, and unequal incomes. How would the court approach care arrangements, maintenance, the flat, and division of matrimonial assets?

My mother died in Singapore without a will. She was remarried, had children from both marriages, held money in CPF accounts, and owned a flat jointly with her spouse. What passes through the estate, who may inherit, and what additional facts are needed?

I own 20% of a Singapore private company. The majority shareholders excluded me from management, refuse access to accounts, and approved large payments to themselves. What director duties and minority-shareholder remedies should I consider?

My Singapore employer introduced software that continuously records staff screens, location, and keystrokes without a clear notice. What privacy and employment-law obligations may apply, and what information or correction requests can employees make?

A former colleague falsely accused me of taking bribes in a large Singapore Telegram channel, and the post was forwarded to clients. What are the elements and possible defences in a defamation claim, and what immediate remedies could reduce the damage?

Singapore police asked me to attend an interview about suspected cheating and said I am not under arrest. What should I understand about statements, access to counsel, and requests for my phone or passwords before I attend?

My uncle lived in Malaysia but owned a Singapore apartment and bank accounts. His Malaysian will appoints me as executor. What Singapore probate or resealing process may be needed before I can manage the assets?

A customer owes my Singapore business S$18,000 for completed renovation work but alleges minor defects and refuses to pay anything. Which dispute-resolution forum may apply, what evidence matters, and how should I frame the claim and any response to the defects allegation?

A Singapore doctor failed to follow up an abnormal test result, and my diagnosis was delayed for a year. What must be established in a medical-negligence claim, how are causation and damages assessed, and what complaint or litigation steps should I consider?

My Singapore company prepaid a supplier in Indonesia under a contract governed by Singapore law with a Singapore arbitration clause. The supplier has stopped responding and may be moving assets. What contractual, interim, arbitration, and enforcement options should I assess?
